title: Sites
description: Sites, clients and endpoint groups of namespace {{namespace}}, with URI rules and the site switch
noNamespace: Select a namespace to manage its sites.

list.title: Sites
list.noMatch: No site on this page matches.
list.emptyDescription: Create a site to start scheduling identities and proxies for it.

form.createDescription: A _default endpoint group is created for every client.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, _, . and -; up to 64 characters. Cannot be changed later.
form.clientsHint: Client types such as web or app (lower-case letters, digits, _ and -; up to 32 characters). Empty defaults to {{defaults}}.
form.clientsEditHint: Adding a client creates its _default endpoint group. A client that still has identities cannot be removed.
form.clientsPlaceholder: Add a client and press Enter
form.clientsRemoved: Removing {{clients}} deletes their endpoint groups and rules; it fails while identities still use them.

name.pattern: Use 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, _, . or -, starting with a letter, digit or _.

clients.required: A site needs at least one client.
clients.duplicate: Each client may appear only once.

delete.title: Delete site {{name}}?
delete.description: Deletes the site with its endpoint groups, URI rules, identity types, identities, accounts and policy bindings. This cannot be undone.
delete.identitiesWarning_one: This site still has {{formatted}} identity. It is deleted permanently together with the site.
delete.identitiesWarning_other: This site still has {{formatted}} identities. They are deleted permanently together with the site.
delete.force: I understand: delete the site and all of its identities.

pause.pauseDescription: While paused, every lease request for this site is refused with site_paused. Leases in flight continue until they are released.
pause.resumeDescription: Lease requests for this site are accepted again.
pause.reasonPlaceholder: Why is the site paused? Shown to operators and recorded in the audit log.

groups.createDescription: Endpoint groups are the unit of rotation, cooldown and circuit breaking. Add URI rules after creating it.
groups.name: Name
groups.nameImmutable: Client and name cannot be changed.
groups.lowWatermarkHint: Alert when fewer identities are available; 0 disables the alert.
groups.belowWatermark: Available identities are below the low watermark
groups.deleteDescription: Deletes the group with its URI rules and policy bindings. Requests that matched its rules fall back to other rules or _default. This cannot be undone.
groups.emptyDescription: Create an endpoint group for URIs with similar risk behavior.

errors.lowWatermark: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.

name.pattern: Use 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, _, . or -, starting with a letter, digit or _.
name.reserved: _default exists for every client and cannot be created.

rules.title: URI rules of {{name}}
rules.priority: Match priority: exact, then template (more literal segments first), then prefix (longest first), then regex (in list order), then _default. Order matters for regex rules and template ties; drag the handle or use the arrows (or arrow keys on the handle) to reorder.
rules.emptyDescription: Without rules no request matches this group; add rules below.
rules.defaultDescription: The _default group receives every request whose path matches no rule of the client.
rules.discardDescription: Your edits to the rule list will be lost.
rules.dragHandle: Reorder rule {{position}}: drag, or press the up and down arrow keys

hints.no_query_fragment: Remove "?" and "#": only the path is matched, never the query or fragment.
hints.whitespace: The pattern must not contain spaces or control characters.
hints.braces_literal: Braces are matched literally here; use a template rule for {parameters}.
hints.wildcard_literal: "*" is matched literally; use a prefix or regex rule for wildcards.
hints.prefix_no_trailing_slash: Without a trailing "/" this prefix also matches longer names (for example /items for /item).
hints.template_segment: Segment {{segment}}: a parameter must fill the whole segment, like {name}.
hints.template_no_params: No {parameters}: this template behaves like an exact rule.
hints.regex_unsupported: RE2 does not support lookahead, lookbehind or backreferences.
hints.regex_invalid: The expression looks invalid ({{message}}); the server validates it as RE2.
hints.regex_unanchored: Regex rules match anywhere in the path; add ^ and $ to anchor them.
hints.duplicate: This kind and pattern already appear above.

tester.title: URI tester
tester.description: Resolve a request URI to its endpoint group, matching rule and effective policies.
tester.noRuleMatched: No rule matched; the _default group applies.
